summary.name: Switch
summary.one_liner: Switch is a free macOS window switcher that lists every open window (including windows on other Spaces) so you can cycle through and filter windows instead of apps.
use_cases: switch between individual windows of the same app on macOS
find a window by typing part of its title
jump to a window on another macOS Space
replace the default Command-Tab app switcher
quickly close, quit or hide windows from the keyboard
summary.what_it_does: Switch replaces the default macOS Command-Tab behaviour so that each window gets its own slot rather than each app. Pressing Command-Tab cycles through windows, most recent first, with live thumbnails. Typing filters the list to narrow down the window you want, and numbers 1–9 pick a window directly. Windows on other Spaces are included, and selecting one takes you to that Space. Option-backtick cycles only the windows of the front app, and the picker can stay open after releasing Command. Thumbnails can be shown in a grid or a single-column list, and apps can be excluded from the picker.
notable: Every window gets its own slot in the Command-Tab switcher, with live thumbnails
Type-to-filter, number keys, and HJKL navigation inside the picker
Lists and switches to windows on other Spaces
caveats: Licence is FSL-1.1-MIT per the page, which is source-available rather than a standard OSI open-source licence
